name: costaatt-cmms
description: COSTAATT Campus Services CMMS/Work-Order Management System

scripts.dev:all-mobile: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
scripts.db:setup: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:api:fix && npm run lint:web:fix
